{{Top|leg}}
The '''Zizimaak Archipelago''' was a large [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] island chain. Located off the [[Northern Continent]]'s southern coast, the archipelago stretched into the [[Central Ocean]]. Many of the islands had [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]]-high spires, and they were inhabited by the [[Zizimaak]].
